'''Tower Ridge''' was a sandy ridge on the outskirts of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], overlooking the nearby [[Desert/Legends|desert]]. Tower Ridge was the location of the first [[Subspace/Legends|subspace]] transmission antenna set up on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], as well as one of the planet's first [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Tower Ridge Water Silo|storage silo]]. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the structures were unused, and the silo had become the home of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Slag Flats]].<ref name="Manhunt" />
